source.title: Can Enchanting be profitable if i've already invested 25 points into disenchanting? (Dec 14 bracer-shuffle firsthand comment)

quote: Just finished a 180 bracer disenchanting session, got 155 shards and 304 dust
notes: New independent post-launch Dec 2022 comment, distinct from the Nov 2022 500-band beta cohort (reddit ymruks). Player states 180 actual bracer disenchants, 155 Vibrant Shard units and 304 Chromatic Dust units. Input described only as cheap bracers using 4 cloth and 4 threads; recipe independently matches Surveyor's Cloth Bands (193497; spell 376509), but author did not explicitly confirm the item, so inputItemID remains null. Crafting Resourcefulness was not accounted for and is unrelated to counting the 180 completed disenchants. DE skill/spec, output occurrences, zero outcomes and stack histogram unknown. The author's nearby 0.8 shards/bracer remark is a prior approximation, not a measured P(hit) from this session.
inputName: Unspecified inexpensive crafted Dragonflight cloth bracers (candidate Surveyor's Cloth Bands 193497; unconfirmed)
